devdoc.details: The Olympus Clearinghouse Registry Module tracks the lending facilities that the Olympus         protocol deploys to satisfy the Cooler Loan demand. This allows for a single-soure of truth         for reporting purposes around the total Treasury holdings as well as its projected receivables.

INIT().details: This function is called when the module is installed or upgraded by the kernel.MUST BE GATED BY onlyKernel. Used to encompass any initialization or upgrade logic.

returns.major: - Major version upgrade indicates breaking change to the interface.
returns.minor: - Minor version change retains backward-compatible interface.

params.active_: Address of the active Clearinghouse. Set to address(0) if none.
params.inactive_: List of inactive Clearinghouses. Leave empty if none.

devdoc.title: Olympus Clearinghouse Registry

ClearinghouseActivated(address).notice: Logs whenever a Clearinghouse is activated.         If it is the first time, it is also added to the registry.

ClearinghouseDeactivated(address).notice: Logs whenever an active Clearinghouse is deactivated.

VERSION().notice: Returns which semantic version of a module is being implemented.

activateClearinghouse(address).notice: Adds a Clearinghouse to the registry.         Only callable by permissioned policies.

active(uint256).notice: Tracks the addresses of all the active Clearinghouses.

activeCount().notice: Count of active and historical clearinghouses.

changeKernel(address).notice: Function used by kernel when migrating to a new kernel.

constructor.notice: Can be initialized with an active Clearinghouse and list of inactive ones.

deactivateClearinghouse(address).notice: Deactivates a clearinghouse from the registry.         Only callable by permissioned policies.

registry(uint256).notice: Historical record of all the Clearinghouse addresses.
